chunks: And Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥadhdhāʾ narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"Any dhimmī who buys land from a Muslim is liable for khums upon it."

key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: the one-fifth tax due in specific legally defined cases
key_terms.ذِمِّيٍّ: a non-Muslim living under the protection and covenant of the Islamic polity
key_terms.مُسْلِمٍ: a Muslim seller in this transaction

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a dhimmī buys land from a Muslim in Shi'i fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a dhimmī who purchases land from a Muslim. It establishes that khums becomes due in this case, making the report relevant to discussions of financial law and khums in Shi'i jurisprudence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1653 - Abu Ubaydah al-Haddha’ narrated from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Any non-Muslim under the protection of Islam (dhimmi) who buys land from a Muslim is obligated to pay Khums on it."
